mcqs.question: The National Tourism Mart–2025 in Visakhapatnam was organised by which combination?
options: AP Tourism Department and Association of Domestic Tour Operators of India (ADTOI)
AP Tourism Department and B2B networking representatives
Association of Domestic Tour Operators of India (ADTOI) and destination presentation organisers
Association of Domestic Tour Operators of India (ADTOI) and FAM trip organisers
mcqs.explanation: The National Tourism Mart–2025 was organised by the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Department with the Association of Domestic Tour Operators of India (ADTOI), under a signed MoU. The other options wrongly treat activities associated with the event as organising bodies.

mcqs.question: What was the principal aim of the National Tourism Mart–2025 in Visakhapatnam?
options: To boost domestic tourism through B2B networking, destination presentations and FAM trips
To boost domestic tourism through B2B networking and destination presentations only
To boost domestic tourism through destination presentations and FAM trips only
To boost domestic tourism through B2B networking and FAM trips only
mcqs.explanation: The Mart aimed to boost domestic tourism through B2B networking, destination presentations and familiarisation (FAM) trips. The other options omit one of these three stated components.
